products.title: Toe Kick
review_reasons: Assembled W/H/D and configuration require further verification; shipping units are not used as cabinet measurements
products.dimension_evidence: Complete your base cabinets with a recessed toe kick that improves standing comfort while concealing cabinet legs and the base structure. Available in cabinet-matching finishes or a contrasting shadow-line look. A toe kick is that recessed strip at the bottom front of base cabinets . It’s intentionally set back so your toes can slide under when you stand close to the counter—way more comfortable and ergonomic. Why it matters Comfort: Lets you stand closer without bending. Clean look: Hides cabinet legs/base structure. Durability: Takes the hits from shoes, mops, vacuums. Typical specs (North America) Height: ~4" Depth (recess): ~3" Finish: Matches cabinet (white, oak, walnut) or black for a shadow-line effect.

Premium Construction Quality – Built with high-grade materials for durability and a solid structure. Modern Aesthetic – Clean edges, smooth finishes, and a minimalist look enhance any custom closet. Color Options – Available in Dark Walnut, Light Oak, and White to match your full closet system. Easy Installation – Pre-drilled holes and accurate sizing ensure a perfect fit above standard corner units.
